sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
roleSessionChanged: Administrator access is ready. Sign in again and verify with your authenticator.
registerIntro: Join a space for dialogue and action together.
loginIntro: Sign in to keep building together.
verifyIntro: To finish signing up, open the confirmation link if it arrives. Check your inbox and spam folder. During testing, delivery may be limited to approved addresses.
forgotIntro: Enter your email to receive a recovery link.
resetIntro: Your recovery link lets you update your password.
passwordHint: At least 8 characters, including a letter and a number.
invalidPassword: Password must have at least 8 characters, a letter, and a number.
invalidName: Display name must have 2 to 80 characters.
invalidCredentials: Email or password is incorrect, or the email is not confirmed.
genericError: We could not complete this action. Please try again.
confirmationUnavailable: Confirmation email is unavailable for this address while email delivery is limited to approved test addresses.
resetSent: If an account exists and the address can receive recovery email, a reset link may arrive. Check your inbox and spam folder.
sessionNeeded: This link is invalid or expired. Request a new link.
onboardingIntro: Choose what to share. Your residence details stay private.
profileIntro: Update your public and private information.
dashboardIntro: Community spaces are coming soon. Your profile is ready for what comes next.
loadError: We could not load your profile. Please try again.
saveError: We could not save your profile. Check the details and try again.
privateNote: Your residence details stay private and do not appear on your public profile.
countryCodeHint: Use a two-letter country code, such as BR or DO.
